subject: Re: CNC kickoff — learned normalized cuts for corpus clustering
body:
Status.

Reproduction: done. On the reference setups our CNC loss converges to the expected normalized cuts values and the cluster assignments match spectral clustering's, as in the paper. The end-to-end differentiable formulation trains stably once we got the learning-rate schedule right (it's sensitive early — Umar's warmup fix in the repo).

Bake-off, first pass on the production shard: quality is at parity (within 0.3 on our internal cluster-coherence metric) and inference is where the win is — assigning new documents to clusters is a forward pass, vs re-running the eigenspace embedding. Incremental updates go from a nightly batch job to near-online.

Risk/trade-off: full-graph training on the shard's affinity graph is memory-hungry; we're training on sampled subgraphs and there's a quality wobble (~0.5) depending on sampling rate. Umar wants one more sweep before we lock the recommendation.

Quentin
